targetCompanyImage.name: Prince George's County Blueprint Schools Program (Phase One)
targetCompanyImage.description: Prince George's County Blueprint Schools Program (Phase One) is a bundled public-private partnership for six public schools in Prince George's County, Maryland. Its end users are students, educators, and the county school system, with value supported by a long-term design-build-finance-maintain school concession rather than by private-pay revenue. The model is asset-heavy and availability-based, with private-sector responsibility for delivery and long-term maintenance. Public materials describe the phase as five middle schools and one K-8 school delivered under a 30-year contract, with more than 8,000 students benefiting from the new facilities. The reviewed materials did not disclose project-level revenue or the current project-company ownership percentages. Fengate-led Prince George's County Education and Community Partners reached commercial and financial close in 2021, opened five schools in 2023, and opened the sixth and final school in 2024.

milestones.event: Fengate-led Prince George's County Education and Community Partners achieved commercial and financial close on the six-school alternative construction financing project.
Fengate and its partners celebrated the opening of the first five schools in the bundle.
The sixth and final school, Colin L. Powell K-8 Academy, opened and completed Phase One.
